hooks.command:
PROJECT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ ! -f "$PROJECT/CLAUDE.md" ] && exit 0; RECENT=$(git -C "$PROJECT" log --oneline -20 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$RECENT" ] && exit 0; /Users/mr.ayman/.npm-global/bin/claude -p "Update the Changelog section in CLAUDE.md (at $PROJECT/CLAUDE.md). Recent git commits from this session:
$RECENT

Rules: (1) Add a new dated entry under the correct month heading, or append to today's entry if one exists. (2) Keep each line concise — one change per bullet. (3) Preserve ALL other sections exactly as-is. (4) Do not output anything, just edit the file." --allowedTools "Read,Edit,Write,Bash" 2>/dev/null || true
